{{Quote|I am death itself, child. Come embrace the darkness!|Lord Grathan|<ref name="TOR:LW" />}}
'''Grathan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He rebelled against the [[Dark Council]] and organized a private base of operations in [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], though his ambition eventually suffered a crippling blow by [[Darth Baras]]'s [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]].<ref name="TOR:LW" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|Grathan's trouble, see. Big trouble. Mad scientist type. Likes weapons. Cyborgs. Droids. Ergonomic chairs.|[[Bryn (Human)|Bryn]]|<ref name="Strange Weapons">{{TORcite|type=general|Strange Weapons|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref>}}
Some time into the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Grathan went rogue and declared himself the thirteenth [[Dark Council]] member, with his own power base and sphere of influence within the Sith hierarchy. Although his claim had not been widely recognized, he controlled a substantial private army on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. The Dark Council authorized all-out warfare against Grathan and anyone who supported him.<ref name="Codex Forces">{{TORcite|type=codex|Grathan Forces}}</ref>

After being driven from the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Citadel]], Lord Grathan holed up in [[Lord Grathan's estate|his estate]] outside Kaas City,<ref name="Codex Forces" /> a fortress protected by experimental shielding.<ref name="Codex Estate">{{TORcite|type=codex|Grathan Estate}}</ref> His [[Lord Grathan's forces|forces]] there were made up of apprentices, loyal [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] troops and [[Cyborg/Legends|cybernetic supersoldiers]] he developed in his secret weapons labs. His cadre of elite [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] &mdash; some volunteers, others kidnapped and forced into service &mdash; developed a seemingly endless number of [[Battle droid/Legends|war droids]], reducing attrition in Grathan's army to near zero.<ref name="Codex Forces" /> [[Vereta Fraabaal]] was one of his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]].<ref name="TOR:FC" />

{{GameDS}}
Willing to show Grathan he was not untouchable as he thought, [[Darth Baras]] commanded [[Empire's Wrath|his apprentice]] to invade his estate and assassinate his [[Beelzlit Grathan|son]]. Grathan's [[Cellvanta Grathan|wife]] tried to bargain her son's life for her husband's, but Baras' apprentice eventually slew both mother and son.<ref name="TOR:LW" />
{{Endgame}}

At some point, Grathan came into possession of the [[Revan's mask|mask]] of [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], which he stored deep within his vaults. He lost it when the [[Order of Revan]] executed a heist on his estate and retrieved the mask, after which it eventually came back into the possession of Revan himself.<ref name="TOR:TMOR" />

One of Grathan's many schemes involved attempting to send messages off-world to an exiled Lord of the Sith, [[Tytonus]], who had at one point attempted to conquer an Imperial world for herself. These messages contained schematics of Kaas City, among other things, allowing Tytonus to mount an invasion using a small army of mercenaries built around a core of Sith adepts who she had trained herself. Because most of the Imperial army was deployed across the galaxy as a consequence of the Empire's overexpansion during the previous war, there was a serious risk that she might have succeeded in seizing the capital, which would have been a disaster for the Empire at broad.<ref>{{TORcite|type=codex|Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> However, a strike team of Imperials managed to destroy her fleet of shuttles and kill her, halting her invasion and, by proxy, Grathan's attempt to destabilize the Dark Council. Major [[Shellaster (major)|Shellaster]], who was responsible for organizing the strike team, noted that although nobody could prove Grathan was behind the transmissions or the invasions, it didn't matter--anyone who mattered knew, and as a consequence Grathan was already losing what little support he had left.<ref>{{TORcite|type=heroic|Friends of Old|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref>   

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Grathan first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as an enemy during the Sith Warrior storyline on Dromund Kaas. According to conversation files, Grathan's name was originally "Lord [[Rathari]]", and his wife and son were Cellvanta Rathari and Beelzlit Rathari respectively. However, the name "Rathari" was later used on a Sith Lord on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] instead of him. A character model labeled "Lord Grathan," albeit a default one with no textures or details, is also present with the fully-qualified name of "npc.​location.​companion.​sith_warrior.​jaesa.​lord_grathan", indicating that Grathan at one point was planned to be involved with the companion missions for [[Jaesa Willsaam]].

Lord Grathan's fate is upon player's choice. Players can choose to kill his wife and son (Dark side decision) or spare their lives and kill Lord Grathan himself, letting his son take his place secretly (Light side decision).<ref name="TOR:LW" />
